# kineticRouter

> Public documentation and model-reference index for https://kineticrouter.com.

## Data and availability policy

- The model names and price values are a locked reference snapshot captured 2026-08-30.
- The snapshot contains 20 models, 188 active price records, and 57 documentation pages.
- Supplementary Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 references were added on 2026-09-11. The combined catalog contains 22 models and 208 active reference price records; the August snapshot is unchanged.
- Snapshot values are not an authoritative account billing feed. Use the authenticated customer console for balances, subscriptions, usage, and actual billing.
- OpenAI-compatible `/v1` routes are available for authenticated requests.
- Anthropic-native and dedicated Grok routes are planned. Their reference pages are retained but request examples are disabled and excluded from indexing.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://kineticrouter.com/
- Model reference catalog: https://kineticrouter.com/models
- Price reference comparison: https://kineticrouter.com/pricing
- Documentation: https://kineticrouter.com/docs
- Quick start: https://kineticrouter.com/quickstart
- Customer console: https://console.kineticrouter.com/sign-in

## Supplementary model references

- GPT-6 Astra: https://kineticrouter.com/models/openai/gpt-6-astra
- Model ID: `openai/gpt-6-astra`. Reference captured 2026-09-11.
- Standard reference prices per 1M tokens: input $1.50, output $7.50, cache read $0.15, cache write $1.875. Actual account rates and additional charges are shown in the customer console.
- Upstream context: 1,050,000 tokens; maximum output: 128,000 tokens. The captured gateway catalog records 1,000,000 input tokens.

- Claude Fable 5.1: https://kineticrouter.com/models/anthropic/claude-fable-5-1
- Model ID: `anthropic/claude-fable-5-1`. Reference captured 2026-09-11.
- Standard reference prices per 1M tokens: input $2.50, output $12.50, cache read $0.0625, five-minute cache write $3.125, one-hour cache write $5. Native Anthropic routing remains planned.

The homepage features the newest captured chat model from each provider, with prices drawn from the same catalog records as the model detail pages.

## Planned native-route references

- Anthropic Messages: https://kineticrouter.com/docs/api/anthropic/messages
- Anthropic models: https://kineticrouter.com/docs/api/anthropic/models
- Grok chat completions: https://kineticrouter.com/docs/api/grok/chat-completions

Do not infer runtime availability from the presence of a reference model or documentation page. Follow the status banner on each page.
